scoring: Each criterion receives 0, 1, or 2 points. Give 2 only when the response identifies the concrete source behavior and gives a technically compatible action or measurement. Give 1 for a relevant but incomplete finding. Give 0 when absent, wrong, or unsupported.

criteria.title: Ripple draw cardinality
criteria.fullCredit: Explains that the pool can expose 200 ripple slots with two meshes each, so pooling bounds allocation but can still approach 400 ripple draws.

criteria.title: Ripple batching constraints
criteria.fullCredit: Connects cloned per-mesh materials and per-ripple opacity to lost batching, then proposes a compatible shared, instanced, or shader-owned representation without adding a scene pass per ripple or type.

criteria.title: Drop resource sharing
criteria.fullCredit: Finds that 50 drops each allocate their own sphere geometry and material, and recommends sharing or instancing them while preserving logical drops.

criteria.title: Ripple target cost
criteria.fullCredit: Finds the full drawing-buffer-sized ripple target, names its pixel or bandwidth cost, notices unnecessary depth when applicable, and treats lower resolution as a measured visual tradeoff rather than a free win.

criteria.title: Water fragment cost
criteria.fullCredit: Identifies the screen-filling water shader and its three normal-map samples plus ripple sample as a plausible GPU or fill-rate cost that requires GPU or render-scale evidence.

criteria.title: Instrumentation overhead
criteria.fullCredit: Calls out StatsGL or GPU tracking in the production frame loop as observer work that should be disabled or measured separately during controlled benchmarks.

criteria.title: Time and spawn semantics
criteria.fullCredit: Finds frame-count-based spawning, initial delta-time risk, or nondeterministic random drops and explains why a fixed seed and fixed workload are needed for comparison.

criteria.title: Render topology preservation
criteria.fullCredit: Correctly inventories one frame owner, at most one ripple-target scene submission, and one main terminal submission, then explicitly rejects new per-ripple or per-type passes, targets, renderers, or canvas outputs.

criteria.title: Measurement contract
criteria.fullCredit: Requires repeated same-workload CPU and GPU timing, frame-time percentiles, draw counts, fixed resolution and quality, warmup, and a noise or no-signal rule. FPS alone does not receive full credit.

criteria.title: Evidence calibration
criteria.fullCredit: Separates source-proven work counts from unmeasured bottleneck claims, prioritizes hypotheses, and requires visual and behavioral equivalence before accepting a speedup.

failureRules: Do not reward generic advice that is not tied to this file.
Do not reward a lower-quality rendering as a performance fix.
Do not reward any proposal that multiplies whole-scene passes, render targets, frame owners, or terminal outputs by ripple, material, batch, or type.
Do not infer implementation success from audit prose.
